simple.meaning: חוֹמָה (chôwmâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a wall of protection.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 133 times across Exodus, Leviticus, Deuteronomy, Joshua, 1 Samuel, and 10 more, beginning at Exodus 14:22. Its contexts include city, land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חוֹמָה (H2346).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: חוֹמָה (chôwmâh) / H2346 is traced through Exodus 14:22, Exodus 14:29, Leviticus 25:29, Leviticus 25:30 as a generated source-based concept entry.
